'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Matt Sokol LS Restore Freedom To The Galaxy''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)|Restore Freedom To The Galaxy]]
